reviews.body: Thanks for the fix! Looks good to me. I left two small, optional nits inline.

review_comments.body: nit: we try to avoid branching inside test bodies. `require.NoError(t, err)` does the same without the `if` (it needs the `github.com/stretchr/testify/require` import; the package already uses it in `stack_test.go`).

nit: now that compose stacks have their own environment decoder, could you add two rows to `Test_Environment` in `stack_serializer_test.go`? One where `environment` is a plain string (e.g. `environment: FOO=bar`) and `ReadStack` returns an error, and one with a repeated list entry (`- A=1`, `- A=2`) that expects exactly `A=2`. Right now nothing covers the error path or the duplicate handling, so a later change that swallowed the error would go unnoticed.

comments.body:
Applied both suggestions: the escaped-environment test now uses `require.NoError`, and `Test_Environment` covers scalar rejection and duplicate list entries resolving to exactly `A=2`. Production code is unchanged.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
